content: LSTM is a type of recurrent neural network (RNN), which is designed for solving the exploding and diminishing gradients of basic RNNs BIBREF23 . It has been widely used in a number of NLP tasks, including POS-tagging BIBREF11 , BIBREF24 , parsing BIBREF25 and machine translation BIBREF26 , because of its strong capabilities of modeling natural language sentences.
